rows.name: Profilering genom fritt val av kurser

notes: HT26 education plan states that the first two years form an integrated base block across biology, chemistry, physics, oceanography and marine geology. Year three permits free course profiling and the programme ends with a 15 hp independent project.
The official plan does not publish one safe course-by-course sequence for the base block, so aggregate year blocks are used rather than invented course rows.
